description: This file defines the 'Rows' class, which manages a collection of table row objects within a document. It includes methods to add, access, and serialize rows, as well as properties controlling row collection behavior and formatting.

classes.name: Rows
classes.description: Represents a collection of table rows, supporting addition, cloning, and serialization, with properties for layout and formatting control.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Rows object.

methods.name: AddRow
methods.description: Adds a new row to the collection, if at least one column exists.
